activity.role: Chairman of the Council of Ministers
activity.notes: Donduk Kuular served as chairman of the Council of Ministers, effectively prime minister, from 1925 until the Soviet-backed political overthrow of his government in January 1929. ATLAS does not inflate this office into an unqualified sole head-of-state reign.

sources.title: Donduk Kuular — biographical reference and cited historical literature
sources.citation_text: The biographical reference, citing Smele and specialist literature on Tuva, records Kuular as chairman of the Council of Ministers from 1925 to 1929 and his removal in the 1929 coup.
